【Generation Goal】
Generate a photoreal shot of the same couple installing the final smaller narrow cabinet board.

【Reference Asset Roles】
@Video1 is a coarse-blockout reference. Use it only for the smaller narrow board's pickup path, translation, downward seating motion, component blocking, action timing, and static camera; do not adopt its proxy geometry, simplified materials, empty scene, or lack of people.
@Image1 defines the white cabinet materials, orange CLICKREADY connectors, dark work mat, and bright laundry-room appearance; do not change the motion defined by @Video1.

【Subjects and Relationships】
The cabinet and previously installed wider board are fixed. The man guides the final smaller narrow board from the left while the woman stabilizes the cabinet.
The two people are the SAME throughout: a woman in her early 30s with shoulder-length dark-brown hair in a plain cream knit sweater and blue jeans, and a man in his early 50s with short salt-and-pepper grey hair in a plain light-blue polo and blue jeans. Bright modern laundry room, grey wainscoting, light tile floor, open wood shelves, dark front-load washer/dryer. Plain clothing, no text or logos.

【Event Script】
Use @Video1 as authoritative for the cabinet's exact wide rectangular proportions, every component's dimensions and orientation, the camera view, and the smaller narrow board's complete trajectory; use @Image1 only for photoreal materials and room appearance. At the start, the cabinet lies flat on its back on the mat, the wider narrow board is already installed and fixed, and the final smaller narrow board lies separately to the left, exactly as shown in @Video1. The man grips the smaller board with both hands before it moves and keeps both hands attached while copying its direct pickup, carry, alignment, and downward seating path from @Video1. The woman keeps both hands on the cabinet to hold it fixed. Every piece remains rigid, and no component moves without visible hand support. At the end, the smaller board is seated in the same position and orientation shown in @Video1 and all six components remain installed.

【Maintain Consistency】
Keep the same two people, six continuous components, rigid dimensions, hand contact, room layout, camera axis, and existing installed state. Do not duplicate the narrow board or move the whole cabinet.
